keys.swarm.aura_boulder_roll_desc: A boulder rolls forward the way you face, growing bigger and flattening monsters as it goes, then crumbles.
keys.swarm.aura_boulder_roll_ten: Landslide: a mountain rolls across the whole screen.
keys.swarm.aura_molten_ground_desc: Stand still and lava wells up around you, spreading wider the longer you hold; walk off and it cools.
keys.swarm.aura_molten_ground_ten: Magma Sea: While standing still, you send out a lava wave every 2 seconds, leaving burning pools.
